foundationInfo.name: M R S Charity Foundation
foundationInfo.parentOrg: A Future Project of M R S
foundationInfo.mission: Delivering life-changing projects to support vulnerable communities: providing child support, food relief, clean water access, free education, vocational empowerment, and emergency disaster relief.

urgentNotice.headline: Flood & Riverbank Erosion Crisis Emergency Response Active
urgentNotice.description: Providing immediate hot food rations, purified water sachets, and child hygiene packets in northern districts.

announcements.title: A Future Project of M R S
announcements.message: M R S Charity Foundation is an upcoming initiative dedicated to healthcare, education & essential necessities. Support the launch 100% free!

announcements.title: No Money Needed to Donate!
announcements.message: Simply click the Donate button. Our sponsor partners cover 100% of the cost for children’s education & hot midday meals.

announcements.title: Your Click Creates Real Aid
announcements.message: You don’t have to spend a single Taka. Every time you click "Donate", a sponsor link opens in a new tab and funds rural Bangladesh schools.

announcements.title: Click-to-Donate Initiative
announcements.message: No bank card or cash required from your pocket. Click the Donate button anytime to send sponsor-backed emergency relief.

announcements.title: Donate As Many Times As You Wish
announcements.message: Each click opens a different verified sponsor link in a new tab. The more you click, the more free humanitarian aid we deliver!
